purpose: Reproduce official SEP-5 derivation and distinguish a root seed, Ed25519 leaf seed, and expanded signing scalar.
warning: All fixtures are published test credentials. Never fund or reuse these keys. The checker prints no mnemonic, seed, chain code, or scalar bytes.
claims_excluded: proof of randomly generated mnemonic entropy

sources.title: Stellar SEP-5, official Test Cases 1–5
sources.selection: Accounts 0, 1 and 9 from each example; public G-addresses, BIP39 seed and m/44'/148' parent seed.

sources.title: RFC8032 sections 5.1.5 and 6: seed expansion/clamping and scalar group arithmetic
Stellar StrKey encoding: CRC16-XModem and version bytes

dependency.name: PyNaCl
dependency.role: Independent libsodium Ed25519 seed-to-public and scalar-to-public operations; no ZK implementation.

relation.root: S = PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(UTF8(NFKD(mnemonic)), UTF8("mnemonic" + NFKD(passphrase)), iterations=2048, length=64). The salt prefix is the literal string "mnemonic".
relation.leaf: k = SLIP-0010-Ed25519(S, [44 hardened, 148 hardened, account hardened]).
relation.public: a = clamp(SHA512(k)[0:32]); A = a * B; compare A with the CRC-checked official G-address.
relation.distinction: A Shor-capable adversary is modeled as learning a modulo subgroup order, not k or S. This checker obtains a from the published seed and demonstrates no quantum attack.
relation.limits: Reproducing derivation establishes a compatibility vector, not possession proof, entropy measurement, quantum soundness, or correct on-chain authorization.
